PostToolUse.command: node -e "const path = process.env.CLAUDE_FILE_PATH || ''; if (path.match(/\.(js|jsx)$/)) { require('child_process').execSync('npx prettier --write ' + JSON.stringify(path), {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
PostToolUse.description: Auto-format JS/JSX files with Prettier after edit/write

PreToolUse.command: node -e "const path = process.env.CLAUDE_FILE_PATH || ''; if (path.match(/(client\.config\.json|\.env|config\.json)$/)) { process.stderr.write('BLOCK: Writing to ' + path + ' requires explicit approval. This file contains sensitive configuration.'); process.exit(2); }"
PreToolUse.description: Block writes to sensitive config files without approval

Stop.command: node -e "const input = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8'); if (input.includes('test') && !input.includes('PASS') && !input.includes('passing') && !input.includes('Tests:')) { process.stderr.write('WARNING: Tests were mentioned but no evidence of passing tests was shown.'); }"
Stop.description: Check that test evidence has been shown before completing
